newsitem.title: USA: TFC Enterprises to close Dallas center.
newsitem.headline: TFC Enterprises to close Dallas center.

text.p: TFC Enterprises Inc said on Friday it is closing its southwestern regional service center, located in Dallas, effective the first week of November 1996.
Receivables serviced from this location will be moved to the company's Norfolk, VA and Jacksonville, FL service centers, said the company.

Closing the facility is expected to save $1.9 million in salaries and rent annually after accounting for added staff at its other locations, said TFC, which is in the auto and motorcycle financing business for U.S military personnel.
TFC was not immediately available for comment about how many employees were going to be affected.

TFC said it will continue to maintain a loan production office in the Dallas area to serve its dealers in the southwestern region. The company has loan production offices in San Diego, Norfolk, Virginia, as well as Dallas.

Also, the company is closing its accounting office, currently located in Manassas, Virginia, which will be moved to Norfolk, TFC said. The move is expected to cost $600,000 in the fourth quarter, but this will be offset by subletting the office in the future.
